
 Usage: openajar setup [OPTIONS] [STEP]

 Set up openajar on this computer: VMs, GitHub, limits, and your agents.

 Quick start takes good defaults; step by step asks each setting. To change one
 thing, run its step again, like `openajar setup github`.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   [STEP]      <str>  Run one step again: vms, github, limits, agents, web,   │
│                      ssh, check or test-vm.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --yes                 -y              Take every default and ask nothing     │
│                                       (for scripts).                         │
│ --hetzner-token-file          <path>  Read the Hetzner Cloud API token from  │
│                                       this file (- for stdin).               │
│ --docker                              Use Docker on this computer for VMs    │
│                                       (free).                                │
│ --github-token-file           <path>  Read a GitHub token from this file (-  │
│                                       for stdin).                            │
│ --no-web                              Skip the web app (`openajar setup web` │
│                                       adds it later).                        │
│ --home                        <path>  Where openajar keeps its files         │
│                                       (default: ~/.openajar).                │
│ --help                                Show this message and exit.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
